name: bc-dev-mcp
description: MCP server for Business Central AL development — run tests with coverage and debug interactively against the BC dev endpoint
author: Torben Leth <sshadows@sshadows.dk>

scripts.dev: bun run embed-skills && bun run src/mcp/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run embed-skills && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --target=node --outfile dist/index.js
scripts.compile: bun run embed-skills && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --compile --outfile bc-dev-mcp.exe
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run build
